body:
Adds `research/input-twin`: an M/M/1 instrument twin fitted to n real interarrival/service times. Exact delta-method relative error and required sample size (grows as (1-rho)^-2), exact instability probability via F distribution, false SLA certification of the point twin (36-46%), and repair by bootstrap/posterior bounds (delta-method bound under-covers at high load). Stylised; all numbers from `experiments/results.txt`. README, `site/projects.json` entry and homepage build updated (`python site/build.py` prints ok).
